report.md.content_text:
# RIPII world-model benchmark

Decision: **no_advance**. Development evidence only.

Checkpoint selection used validation only. Values are position RMSE mean ± sample standard deviation across initialization seeds.

| Model | In distribution | More objects | Held-out properties | Faster motion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| graph_continuous | 0.1728 ± 0.0054 | 0.1767 ± 0.0130 | 0.1722 ± 0.0026 | 0.3406 ± 0.0198 |
| global_pool_continuous | 0.1575 ± 0.0065 | 0.1560 ± 0.0036 | 0.1674 ± 0.0070 | 0.3321 ± 0.0204 |
| multiscale_continuous | 0.1577 ± 0.0033 | 0.1574 ± 0.0092 | 0.1701 ± 0.0089 | 0.3391 ± 0.0185 |

## Analytic baselines

| Baseline | In distribution | More objects | Held-out properties | Faster motion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| persistence | 0.3582 | 0.3638 | 0.3391 | 0.5098 |
| constant_velocity | 0.2911 | 0.2931 | 0.2539 | 0.5506 |
| force_kinematic | 0.2876 | 0.2906 | 0.2494 | 0.5516 |

## Advancement checks

    "seed": 103,
    "ood_relative_improvement": 0.026660352664079623,
    "id_relative_regression": -0.10043352806110573,

  {
    "seed": 107,
    "ood_relative_improvement": 0.000926678358328159,
    "id_relative_regression": -0.0791935851377712,
    "passes": false
  },
  {
    "seed": 109,
    "ood_relative_improvement": 0.06982745904429077,
    "id_relative_regression": -0.08270169687748818,
    "passes": true
  }
]
